qa_pairs.question: What happens if I drop a course before the census date?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Dropping a course before or on the census date may change your billed credits and scholarship status.

contexts.text: Northstar University uses Fall, Spring, and Summer teaching periods. For Fall 2026, priority registration opens on July 20, regular registration closes on August 14, classes begin on August 17, and the standard add/drop period ends at 17:00 on August 28. The census date is September 4. The last day to withdraw from a course with a `W` grade is October 30, and final examinations run from December 7 through December 12.

qa_pairs.question: How long can a standard leave of absence last?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A standard leave may last one or two consecutive regular terms.

contexts.text: title: Leave of Absence and Withdrawal

qa_pairs.question: Can I get an incomplete grade if I have only completed 50% of the course work?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, an incomplete grade requires at least 70% of assessed work to be complete.

contexts.text: Students are expected to attend at least 80% of scheduled sessions in courses that record attendance. A course syllabus may set a higher threshold when required by accreditation, laboratory safety, or clinical practice, but it may not set a lower threshold. Three consecutive unexplained absences trigger an academic-support alert; the alert itself is not a disciplinary finding.

qa_pairs.question: Who reviews a grade appeal first?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The department chair reviews a grade appeal first.

contexts.text: The Student Success Centre provides study-skills coaching, tutoring referrals, and non-clinical wellbeing navigation. Adjustments are not retroactive unless the office confirms that an exceptional barrier prevented earlier registration. Neither office changes grades or waives essential programme outcomes.

qa_pairs.question: Will staff ever ask for my password or one-time code?

qa_pairs.question: What happens if I have a financial hold when I try to graduate?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A financial hold blocks official conferral and release of the final transcript until resolved.

contexts.text: An undergraduate student is academically eligible to graduate after completing at least 120 applicable credits, all programme-required courses, the capstone requirement, and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.00. At least 30 of the final 45 applicable credits must be completed at Northstar University unless an approved exchange agreement states otherwise.

qa_pairs.question: If I withdraw from all courses before classes begin, is my student-services fee refunded?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes, mandatory term fees are refundable only when you withdraw from every course before classes begin.

contexts.text: Undergraduate tuition for the 2026–2027 academic year is USD 420 per registered credit. The student-services fee is USD 180 in Fall and Spring and USD 90 in Summer. Tuition and mandatory fees are due by the regular registration deadline listed in `01_academic_calendar.md`. A five-calendar-day grace period applies to the account balance, but it does not extend registration or scholarship deadlines.

qa_pairs.question: Do I need permission for an internship credit?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes, it must be approved by the faculty supervisor and career services before starting.

contexts.text: Programmes with an internship requirement require at least 240 verified hours. Before starting, the student must have an approved placement agreement and workplace supervisor. Hours completed before approval do not normally count. The supervisor submits a completion evaluation, and the student submits the programme reflection within ten business days after the placement ends. A student may split the hours across two approved placements, but each placement requires its own agreement.

qa_pairs.question: How many credits are required to graduate?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: At least 120 applicable credits.

contexts.text: title: Graduation and Internship Requirements

qa_pairs.question: If I request a late add on August 5, 2026, how much is the late-add fee?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The fee is USD 40, because requests made on or after August 1, 2026 follow Version 2.0 of the Registration Policy.

contexts.text: Northstar uses the student portal and university email for official account communication. Multi-factor authentication is required for the portal. Staff will never request a password or one-time authentication code. A student who suspects account compromise should change the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, and contact the IT Service Desk. Suspected payment fraud should also be reported to Student Accounts and the student's payment provider.

qa_pairs.question: If my scholarship requires 12 graded credits, and I withdraw from one course after the census date leaving me with 9 completed credits, will I lose my scholarship at the end of the term review?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes, a withdrawal after census counts as attempted credit but not completed credit, which may cause you to fail the end-of-term review.

contexts.text: The Northstar Merit Scholarship covers 50% of undergraduate tuition but does not cover student-services fees, late fees, or late-add fees. Initial awards are based on admission review. Renewal is assessed after each Fall and Spring term; Summer enrolment does not trigger a separate renewal review.

qa_pairs.question: I have an incomplete (I) grade. If I don't finish the work by the end of the next regular term, what happens?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The 'I' grade converts to an 'F' unless an approved extension exists.
